title: Oops! Say It Again?
description: Practice asking for repetition or clarification and repairing everyday communication mix-ups by speaking, showing, pointing, or drawing.
learningFocus: Use flexible communication-repair strategies when a message was not heard, understood, or interpreted as intended.
adultGuidance: Read each situation aloud and accept more than one helpful response, including speaking, showing, pointing, or drawing. On Page 2 the helpful questions are “Which one?”, “Where?”, and “What do you mean?”; on Pages 3–4, invite your child to explain or demonstrate a respectful way to correct the mix-up in their own words.

seo.title: Oops! Say It Again? | Kindergarten Communication Worksheets
